title: I started with curiosity, and it turned into code.
intro: My path moved from learning how programs work to building real projects, then into the space where full-stack development and design meet.
bio: I am Hussein Rajab, a Junior Full-Stack Developer and designer building software from Syria with a global outlook. Informatics Engineering gave my curiosity structure; projects, teaching, and experimentation gave it direction.
cards: I like understanding how things work, not just making them work.
I enjoy turning complicated problems into practical, buildable solutions.
I care about the details, from the underlying logic to the final interface.
